newsitem.title: USA: Zapata ends merger deal with Houlihan's.
newsitem.headline: Zapata ends merger deal with Houlihan's.

text.p: Zapata Corp said on Tuesday that it terminated its merger agreement with Houlihan's Restaurant Group Inc, partly due to a court ruling that 80 percent of Zapata shareholders had to approve the merger.
Zapata Executive Vice President Joseph von Rosenberg III said it would be difficult to meet such a high vote requirement, regardless of circumstances.
The court's ruling had been appealed, but Rosenberg said the results would not be known for a long time.
Zapata said each company had the right to terminate the merger if it was not consummated before October 1.
